name: What are some popular design trends for modern bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular design trends for modern bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern bathroom design trends often emphasize clean lines, minimalist aesthetics, and functionality. Popular choices include floating vanities for a spacious feel, large format tiles for fewer grout lines and a sleek look, and walk-in showers with frameless glass enclosures. Freestanding tubs remain a luxurious focal point. Color palettes often feature neutral tones like whites, grays, and natural wood accents, with pops of color introduced through accessories. Smart technology, such as heated floors, sensor-activated faucets, and smart mirrors, is also gaining popularity, enhancing both comfort and convenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular modern bathroom trends include floating vanities, large format tiles, walk-in showers, freestanding tubs, neutral palettes, and smart technology for comfort and convenience.
